info.title: evaluation
info.description: Immutable regression/development evidence; platform synthetic only. Task and feedback references remain private. No model call or automatic adoption. Visible results are paginated after current evidence authorization; bounded scope window is 1000 objects, excess is explicit 409. Registering requests does not prove provider completion or a bill.
